data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English 'geof' meaning 'God' and 'ric' meaning 'power' or 'rule', Jeffries means 'God's peace'. This name was popular among early Christians due to its religious significance. The name Jeffries carries the meaning “God's peace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jeffries usually hope their child will grow to embody god's peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
